title: ChatGPT Ads Expands to 31 European Markets in 2025
summary: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Ads across 31 European countries, enabling advertisers to reach users during search and decision-making. Full market list inside.
body_markdown:
OpenAI has officially launched ChatGPT Ads across 31 European markets, marking a significant expansion of its conversational advertising platform beyond the United States. The rollout enables brands to connect with users at critical decision-making moments as they research products, compare alternatives, and seek recommendations through ChatGPT interactions.


## Available Markets and Geographic Reach


The European expansion covers major economies and smaller markets alike, providing advertisers with continent-wide reach. Confirmed markets include the United Kingdom, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Netherlands, Belgium, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Ireland, Austria, Switzerland, Poland, Czech Republic, Portugal, Greece, Hungary, and Romania among others. This geographic breadth positions ChatGPT Ads as a pan-European advertising channel capable of reaching diverse linguistic and cultural audiences through a single platform.


Advertisers can now target users across these markets with contextually relevant sponsored messages that appear during natural ChatGPT conversations. The platform maintains OpenAI's stated commitment to user experience by displaying ads that align with ongoing queries rather than interrupting unrelated interactions.


## How the Advertising Platform Works


ChatGPT Ads operates differently from traditional display or search advertising. Sponsored content appears when users ask questions related to specific product categories, travel destinations, purchasing decisions, or service comparisons. The system analyzes conversation context to determine relevance before displaying advertiser messages.


- Ads appear as clearly labeled sponsored responses within chat threads
- Targeting relies on contextual signals rather than extensive personal data collection
- Advertisers access campaign management tools through OpenAI's business portal
- Performance metrics track engagement, click-through rates, and conversion pathways


This conversational approach allows brands to provide information precisely when users demonstrate purchase intent or research behavior, potentially improving conversion rates compared to interruptive advertising formats.


## Availability and Advertiser Access


Officially launched on January 2025, ChatGPT Ads for European markets became available to qualified advertisers through OpenAI's self-service platform. Businesses seeking to participate must meet OpenAI's advertiser guidelines and content policies, which prohibit certain categories including political advertising, misleading health claims, and age-restricted products in jurisdictions where such restrictions apply.


The expansion follows several months of testing in the US market, where OpenAI refined ad delivery algorithms and user experience considerations. European advertisers can now leverage insights from those initial deployments while adapting campaigns for local market conditions and regulatory requirements including GDPR compliance frameworks.


## Privacy and Regulatory Compliance


OpenAI has structured the European rollout to align with the continent's stringent data protection standards. The platform processes advertising interactions under GDPR guidelines, limiting data collection to contextual signals rather than building comprehensive user profiles. Advertisers receive aggregated performance data without access to individual user identifiers or conversation histories.


This privacy-focused architecture addresses European regulatory expectations while maintaining advertising effectiveness. Users retain control over their ChatGPT experience through settings that govern commercial content visibility and data usage preferences.


## What This Means


The European expansion of ChatGPT Ads represents OpenAI's commitment to building sustainable revenue streams beyond subscription models. For advertisers, the platform offers a novel channel to reach engaged users during high-intent moments when traditional ads might feel intrusive. As conversational AI becomes more embedded in daily digital workflows, advertising formats that respect user context while delivering commercial value may define the next generation of digital marketing. European businesses now have early access to test these emerging capabilities across diverse markets and consumer segments.
